facts.text: I am considering switching to the bus for my daily commute.
I commute from Oakdale to downtown every weekday.
I usually pay with a monthly pass for my commute.
I am not eligible for any discounts.
I want to know whether the bus ride would give me enough time to listen to my audiobook during the commute.
I want to know whether the bus ride would give me enough time to get some work done during the commute.
I am concerned that the bus ride could be affected by traffic.
I want a bus route that tends to be less congested or has a dedicated bus lane.
I want to know the Wi-Fi situation on the BRT buses.
I want to know whether the BRT bus Wi-Fi is reliable and fast enough to support my work.
I want to know whether I will be able to charge my laptop on the bus.
I want to know whether there are any power outlets available on the bus.
I want to know whether I will have enough space to open my laptop and work comfortably on the bus.
I want to know whether the seating arrangement and legroom on the bus will allow me to work comfortably with my laptop.

keyphrases: switch to bus for daily commute
